{{Quote|I had a wife, once. I didn't fear her.|Calphayus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was the '''wife''' of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Calphayus]] prior to him becoming one of the [[Dread Masters]]. After all Dread Masters except him had been killed, Calphayus remembered his prior life and regained memories of his wife.<ref name="TOR" />
